nodes.label: Tiered Storage Strategy (Hot/Cold Path)
nodes.rationale: Hot Path: QuestDB/TimeBase-CE for last 24-48h tick data. Cold Path: TimescaleDB for aggregated historical data. QuestDB excels at ingestion speed (4M rows/sec); TimescaleDB is superior for complex join-heavy analytics.

nodes.label: CDM Adapter Layer for Canonical Data Mapping
nodes.rationale: Create a CDM Adapter layer that maps ingested raw data into canonical CDM objects before reaching the ComputationEngine, ensuring standardized data model regardless of source.
